## Environment Check

## Data Overview

For this post, I am analyzing global life expectancy. The dataset used in this analysis is the Gapminder dataset, which provides historical data on life expectancy, GDP per capita, and population by country.

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false

library(gapminder)
library(dplyr)

head(gapminder)
```
